list_managed_pages.description: Lists the Facebook Pages the connected account manages.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return in this page (1 to 100).

after.description: The next_cursor value from a previous call, to fetch the next page.

list_managed_pages.afterResponse:
var items = response.data || [];
return { items: items, count: items.length, next_cursor: response.paging && response.paging.next ? (response.paging.cursors && response.paging.cursors.after != null ? response.paging.cursors.after : null) : null };
